analogs.covers: Group life: a herd that shares one scent, digs tubers, tramples the forest and fights predators together
Family system: one dominant breeding female, several males, and fathers who carry and raise the young

headline: A peccary herd sharing one scent and fighting as a team, run marmoset-style by one matriarch with doting fathers.

setting.label: Forest territories, dug up for tubers
setting.note: Glades claim medium territories; all-male kindles are nomadic. Tramples through forest digging for tubers, rolls in mud or water on the hottest days, and often leaves by following a Barsboldia herd.

playsLike: You are a medium herbivore with strong sex roles. A 'glade' is ruled by one matriarch doe who decides nesting, territory and who eats first; subordinate does must submit, and bucks are gentle, parental and conflict-shy. All-male 'kindles' wander and adopt orphans. Up to 4 fight predators, does first and headstrong, and the whole glade despises raptors. You flee 3+ Large or any Apex carnivore. Infanticide by the matriarch and a 'blight' illness keep the glade tense.

why.text: Scent glands on the neck are rubbed against glade members so everyone smells of the matriarch, as peccaries share one herd odour (official inspiration: white-lipped peccary).
Tramples through forest digging for tubers and knocks down small trees, reshaping the forest the way peccary herds do.
Takes turns running back and forth at predators with kicks and tail slams to overwhelm them, the way peccaries fight jaguars as a group.
Polyandrous bonds, a single dominant breeding female, and bucks that universally nurture and adopt young. Marmoset groups work this way (official inspiration).
Medium tier, 2,400 combat weight, 550 HP, sprint 1,050 held for 133 s.

notLike: Peccaries are not matriarchies with submissive males.
Marmosets are tiny tree-dwellers; they only explain the family system.
twist: Horses and rock hyraxes are official inspirations too.
